## Your task

What were you trying to do? Did you use the offline demo, your own local export, or an AI agent?

## Where the experience helped or stopped

Give the exact documented step/command, expected result, and actual result. Replace private paths and examples. Do not attach real conversations, confirmations, databases, model receipts or credentials.

## Environment

Repository commit, operating system, Python version, and Codex version only when relevant.

## Useful next change

What single change would make this easier? Feedback is welcome whether or not you star the repository.
